messages:
maya: Hi team — I'm Maya (new on infra). Accepted the org invite but when I click the GitHub link it gives 'SAML error: 2FA required' and my YubiKey isn't being prompted on my Mac. Chrome just says 'No credentials found'. Anyone seen this? I need infra repo access for my first-week task.

sam_it: welcome, Maya! :wave: Quick checks — are you on the company laptop and using your work email/login? We enforce hardware key for SSO. Also which browser/version? Okta/SSO sometimes prefers Chrome stable vs Canary.

maya: Using the work laptop and work email. On VPN. Okta phone push works fine, but GitHub redirect fails before it asks for the security key. I'm on Chrome 116.0. Gonna try Safari. Any CLI fallback to get a repo clone in the meantime?

jordan: hey Maya, welcome! For immediate cloning you can use SSH if your public key is attached to your GitHub account. Try: `ssh -T git@github.com` and `GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -v" git clone git@github.com:redwood/infra.git` — paste output if it fails. Also let us know the invite status on the org page (pending/accepted).

maya: Ran `ssh -T` and got: 'Permission denied (publickey)'. I have the public key uploaded to GH (I think). The org invite is marked 'accepted' on the link but the repo list is empty.

sam_it: hm — if the org SSO isn't finishing the device enrollment step GitHub can block org-scoped repo access even if your account shows accepted. Two quick things: 1) verify your SSH key fingerprint on GitHub matches `ssh-keygen -lf ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` 2) try registering the key in Okta (profile -> security devices) if you haven't. Also sometimes U2F vs FIDO config on YubiKey matters.

maya: Fingerprint matches. I don't see an option in Okta to register the YubiKey (only phone and app MFA). My key is plugged in and works for GPG and unlocking. Any chance SSO requires FIDO2 specifically?

sam_it: Yes — our Okta policy is FIDO2-first for hardware keys. If the key is configured in U2F-only mode it might not surface. You can reconfigure the YubiKey to FIDO2 if needed. If you'd like we can escalate to SSO team and grant you temporary repo access while you rekey.

onboard-bot: Automated note: New-hire checklist step 'Org repo access' pending for maya. Contact sam_it for temporary access.

jordan: I can add temporary read access to infra & eng-platform while SSO is sorted — that'll let you clone and inspect code. Ping me when you want PR rights.

maya: Thanks Jordan — please add me, that would unblock me today.

jordan: done — you should now have read access to `redwood/infra` and `redwood/eng-platform`. Wait a minute for permissions to propagate.

maya: Clone succeeded! `git clone` works now. One small Q: when I try to open a draft PR I get 'insufficient permissions' — is that expected with temporary access?

jordan: yes temporary access is read-only. For PR write access we'll wait on SSO fix + team sync. In the meantime create a draft PR in a fork and assign reviewers; we'll help push it through.

maya: Got it. Thanks so much for the quick help! :tada: If you open the SSO ticket can you tag me on updates?

sam_it: will do. filing ticket with SSO team now, refs: #SSO-1089. I'll DM you if they need your key in-hand for reconfiguration.

maya: awesome — appreciate it everyone!
